_comment: Streams that resolve successfully but do not play the advertised content.
These cannot be detected by HTTP status: the server returns 200 and a valid
HLS manifest, so only a rule like this can exclude them.
Users can add their own rules in blocklist.json inside the Winnotix data
directory (%APPDATA%\Winnotix). User rules are merged with these; a user
rule with the same id replaces the built-in one, and setting 'enabled' to
false there switches a built-in rule off.
Each rule needs an id and a reason, plus host_suffix and/or url_regex.

rules.reason: Pluto TV serves a ~25s takedown notice instead of the stream
rules.notes: RE-ENABLED 2026-09-07, and the 2026-09-02 retirement was half wrong. Pluto restored access through the jmp2.uk redirector, which is what that sample measured; the hosts linked *directly* never came back. Reported from use as Free-TV's Pluto channels playing a loop saying the channel is no longer available while iptv-org's played normally. Measured 2026-09-07: 24 of 24 sampled Free-TV entries on service-stitcher.clusters.pluto.tv returned segments under '..._ptv_takedownslates_all_1500/', the same signature as 2026-08-31; the slate clip is dated 20251111, so it has been there since November 2025. Blast radius: 131 of Free-TV's 2,068 entries match, and 0 of iptv-org's 14,403 -- iptv-org links Pluto only through the redirector, so this rule never sees those hosts. The redirector rule below stays off, because that route plays real content.

rules.reason: Pluto TV behind a redirector, same takedown notice
rules.notes: RETIRED 2026-09-02 with the rule above, and for the same reason: the streams behind this redirector play their real content again. It was blocking 2,342 of the 14,307 entries in index.country.m3u, so retiring it returns 16% of the largest bundled playlist. The original finding stands as written: iptv-org does not link to Pluto directly -- it links to the jmp2.uk redirector, which lands on stitcher-ipv4.pluto.tv. The host_suffix rule above matches the URL as written and so never sees these. 2,342 of the 14,307 entries in index.country.m3u go through it (16%); a random sample of 60 resolved 59 to stitcher-ipv4.pluto.tv and one to an HTTP error, none anywhere else. Blocking the redirector by host avoids resolving thousands of URLs at load time.
